title: Varda tile
description: A flat, square-cornered link tile in one of three colour blocks (navy with orange type, solid orange with navy type, off-white with navy type): a small bold eyebrow and a thin up-right arrow along the top, a medium-weight heading pushed to the bottom, and an optional media cell beside or below. The whole tile shifts one shade on hover in 0.3s and the arrow nudges up-right.
notes: the tile is a grid; pass its template in className (e.g. lg:grid-cols-[1fr_2fr]) and the media cell's padding/order in mediaClassName
tones map to background / primary / secondary tokens, hovers to muted / highlight / accent
